payload.reason: The evidence indicates that NCEL outperforms various baselines and achieves significant performance improvements, demonstrating its effectiveness overall.

claims.text: NCEL achieves the best performance with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% on Macro F1.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines, showing favorable generalization ability.
NCEL outperforms all baseline methods in both easy and hard cases.
Trained on collected Wikipedia hyperlinks, NCEL outperforms state-of-the-art collective methods across five datasets.
